summary: Counting patch decorations in the retained-bytes figures, and keeping the decorations handle in the Stashes inspector and the rewritten-series review, draws nothing differently: Compare's unified Diff of a commit, the Stashes inspector's Diff of a stash and the rewritten-series review's Patch of a rewritten commit, each at rest with removed, added and context rows, their gutter tints and word-level highlights, are pixel-identical between base and candidate, in their crops and in the whole window outside the status bar's per-launch timing
limitations: Linux under XWayland at scale factor 1 only, window 1000x800, Midnight at 13 pt. The fixture is built outside the spec, because a recipe has no stash operation, and opened with --fixture at /tmp/gitturtle-evidence/fixtures/decorations-in-retained-bounds-combined/repo, the path the seeded recovery-drafts.json record names; every commit is by GitTurtle QA at a fixed 2026-09-01 UTC minute: base 7db46456 on main; topic's original series d0f44bae, 1ce4dfbd, a097d876 (reset away, kept in the reflogs) and its rewrite 1fa21263, bdfb0130, d28f5a68; HEAD a3e2b0ad on main; stash@{0} 59fed7fd of an unstaged notes.txt edit; worktree clean. The rewritten-series review opens on that seeded RewriteSeries record (branch topic, base 7db46456, original a097d876), not on a rebase run in the app. Its list is driven with the pointer: on the candidate, Return on the focused series list closed the dialog instead of inspecting the selected row's rewritten files. Find over a patch, scrolling, hover, macOS, native Wayland and fractional scales are not covered
